latest_release.name: v0.42.0
latest_release.body:
We are excited to announce the release of mpv 0.42.0.

Key highlights:

* libcurl based network backend with HTTP/2, HTTP/3 and connection reuse
* DVD-Video, Blu-ray HDMV and BD-J menu navigation
* DVD-Audio playback
* Direct playback of .iso images of DVD-Video, DVD-Audio and Blu-ray discs
* Dolby Vision Profile 7 enhancement layer support in `gpu-next`
* MPEG-TS programs and HLS variants are exposed as editions
* DSD-over-PCM (DoP) passthrough with `--audio-spdif=dsd`
* Support for SRV3 (YouTube) subtitles via subrandr library
* Context menu populated from the new `menu.conf`, bound to right click
* `floating` OSC layout with Fluent icons (`--script-opts=osc-layout=floating`)
* API that allows integration between the OSC and (third-party) thumbnailer scripts
* Wayland session management
* Wayland color management through the protocol instead of the Vulkan API
* scRGB output with `--target-trc=scrgb`
* Improved HDR colorspace signalling on DRM (Linux)
* D3D11 render API backend for libmpv
* Reworked terminal video outputs (`sixel`, `kitty` and `tct`)
* AMD Frame Rate Conversion filter (`--vf=amf_frc`)
* Rewritten display-sync audio drift compensation
* `--tls-verify` is enabled by default

This release requires FFmpeg 6.1 or newer and libplacebo 7.387.0 or newer.

Note that the release binary assets are our [CI builds](https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/actions/runs/41936479105). These builds are reasonably useful. The Windows _full_ builds (`*-w64-mingw32-full.zip`) are bigger and aim to provide the complete experience.

# Features

## New

- sub: add subrandr renderer support
- video/filter/vf_amf: add AMD Frame Rate Conversion filter
- mac/common: add support for transparent rendering
- context_menu.lua: implement key hints
- menu.conf: add this file
- select.lua: populate the context menu
- input.conf: add context menu bindings
- vo_gpu_next: add scRGB support
- video/out/opengl/context_wayland: export preferred colorspace
- vo_dmabuf_wayland: add BT.2100 mapping
- wayland_common: add scRGB support
- mpv-osd-symbols: add some Fluent UI System Icons to mpv font
- osc.lua: add `floating` layout
- vo_gpu_next: add stereo osd support
- demux_lavf: add support for programs
- demux_timeline: add support for programs
- vo_gpu: initial support for tunable parameters
- vo_gpu: add support for DEFINE and ENUM parameters
- osc: define and add support for "preview" api
- demux/packet: add support for SMPTE 2094-50 metadata
- vo_gpu: support parameters in RPN expressions
- demux_playlist: add support for 'strm' playlist
- wayland: implement session management
- demux/packet: add support for LCEVC ITU-T35 payloads
- demux_lavf: add support for stream groups
- video: merge the tiles of grid heif and avif images
- stream_curl: add libcurl-based stream backend
- demux_lavf: route nested HTTP opens through the curl backend
- stream_curl: use for ftp/ftps
- video/out/x11_common: add --focus-on support in X11
- hwdec_d3d11va: support 4:4:4 and high bit depth zero-copy formats
- demux_mkv: support demuxing native VC-1 streams
- stream_curl: add support for Icecast metadata
- f_enhancement_pair: add filter to match frames of separate video tracks
- vo_gpu_next: upload/map EL frame
- demux_lavf: add support for splitting EL track from in-band
- demux_mkv: add support for splitting EL track from in-band
- stream_env: add new stream to read from environment variables
- audio/filter: implement lavfi-tempo leveraging lavfi's atempo/ascale
- sd_lavc: add support for DVD sub highlight
- stream_dvdnav: implement DVD menu navigation
- stream_bluray: implement HDMV menu navigation
- demux_disc: add a synthetic "Disc Menu" edition
- stream_bluray: add BD-J menu support
- stream_dvdnav: add support for still frames
- stream_bluray: add support for still frames
- stream_dvda: add DVD-Audio playback support
- stream_dvda: expose DVD-Audio still images as a cover-art video track
